rules: Strict adherence to a 40-second total length to maintain high retention.
Place the visual hook text within the first 3 seconds to anchor the viewer's attention.
Explain complex processes by breaking them into exactly three distinct logical steps.
Include a 'How it works' or 'Why' query in every title to trigger curiosity.
Ensure the transition from the explanation to the 'pause and predict' segment occurs exactly at the 20-second mark.
Use only high-contrast, simple line diagrams or clean, real-world footage.
formats_now: Mechanism Breakdown: Showing how a complex machine (like a turbine or gear) functions, as it is highly searchable.
Visual Paradoxes: Presenting a counter-intuitive physical result and explaining the 'why' behind it.
Applied Physics in Real World: Linking abstract science to a relatable event like a bridge build or a structural design.
The 'Hidden Path': Explaining the invisible process behind a common technology (e.g., cables, signals).
hook_shapes: Ever thought why X happens? Most people get it wrong.
X seems simple, but the science behind it is actually Y.
You’ve used X your whole life, but do you know how it actually works?
title_shapes: How X works: The [Scientific Principle] Explained
Why does X happen? The physics of [Topic]
Ever thought why X is designed like Y?
topic_areas: Material science (why specific materials are used in construction)
stop_doing: Avoid content longer than 60 seconds as it leads to audience drop-off.
Stop using complex jargon that requires an external search to understand.
Do not include generic 'subscribe' or 'like' calls to action as they distract from the loop.
experiment: Test the impact of placing the title card on a bright, solid-colored background versus overlaying it on the footage. Success will be measured by a higher Average Percentage Viewed (APV) in the first 5 seconds.
